item.description: ### Fixed - **ZPA:** a re-run whose plan only updates existing application segments can now be applied, and the Dry Run and Apply pages count updates as well as creates. - **ZIA:** an Apply whose only changes are rules or the DLP engine updated in place now activates them; before, they waited in ZIA until someone else activated. - **Crash fixes:** the app no longer closes when an address in a ZPA destination or a Client Connector list has digits other than 0-9 (Arabic-Indic or full-width ones, for example): it's refused as an invalid address. Nor when Client Connector or ZDX asks for a very long rate-limit wait (it reads "a long time"), or reports a device type that isn't a whole number.
